name: Proving Grounds 29: The Unmade Reach. The final boss's own domain outside the world: pieces of Hollowmark hung in a violet void under a black sun, climbing from the street where you arrive (0) to the throne (12). Three ways up: the Drifting Steps, lone stones a level apart to the chapel (4) and the Overlook (8) above the causeway; the Broken Causeway, a spine of land climbing 2, 4, 6 by zig-zag stairs, watched from both sides; the Chained Isles, climbed a level at a time but joined only by one-wide bridges, the last long and under the summit. All meet on the summit's outer ring (8); the inner ring (10) stands behind a cliff with a stair at each side and a narrow one in the middle, and the dais (12) above it.
